Campaign Headquarters 
129 Nanking Road 
December 7, 1937 

Major F. W. Gerrard 

Commissioner of Police 

Municipal Council 

Shanghai 

Sir, 

The Shanghai International Red Cross is conducting 
a campaign to raise funds to carry on its work of giving 
relief to the hundreds of thousands of refugees now 
within the International Ssttlement, the French Conces- 
sion and in the Nantao Safety Zone. The need is very 
urgent, and the Campaign Committee desires to conduct 
an appeal by radio. 

I have the honour therefore to submit to you the 
accompanying documents containing the texts of the 
dialogue of the items to be broadcasted in connection 
with this campaign. Ifeel confident that as these items 
are being currently rendered commercially, you will find 
no objection to them for this charitable purpose. No 
material of a political nature, or any utterances that 
might disturb the peace of this community, will be used 
in this connection. 

I feel that I need not emphasize to you the obvious 
benefit of such work to the community in providing 
relief and lessening the danger cf outbreak of lawless- 


ness and of epidemics among these unfortunates. It is 


Page 2 


hoped therefore that your approval of this radio appeal 
will soon be available, so as to enable us to begin this 
phase of the current campaign without delay. If it would 
expedite the matter, we shall be glad to send a repre- 
sentative to see you personally and answer any questions 
you might wish to ask. 

Thanking you, I am 


Yours faithfully, 


(Mrs.) Arthur N. Young, 
Chairman, Campaign Committee. 


Copy to Major Bourne

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
No. S. B. D 8215
Date 5-6-42

S. B., Special Branch Station. File No. ____ Date June 2, 1942.

SUBJECT: International Red Cross Association-
free distribution of wheat.

Sir,

With reference to my report dated May 4, 1942,
on the subject "International Red Cross Association,
No. 97 Yuen Ming Yuen Road - proposed free distribu-
tion of wheat", further enquiries have been made
and it has been ascertained that the association
has removed 14,900 bags of cracked wheat from
various godowns some three weeks ago with the
permission of the Japanese authorities. The consi-
gments of wheat were received from the U.S.A. by
the American Red Cross Association in Shanghai
prior to December 8, 1941 and contributed by the
American People.

The procedure of the distribution of the wheat
in question is shown on a list attached. This list
was handed to the undersigned by Mr. Ed. Egle, Swiss,
Manager of Siber Hegner & Co., No. 97 Yuen Ming Yuen
Road, who is the committee member of the International
Red Cross Association.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）Wan Bron Man
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,
Special Branch.

日期 1942年6月5日

S. B.，特科分站。档案号 ____ 日期 1942年6月2日。

事由：国际红十字会协会——
免费分发小麦。

先生：

关于我于1942年5月4日就“国际红十字会协会，圆明园路97号——拟议免费分发小麦”一事提交的报告，经进一步查询，已查明该协会约在三周前在日本当局许可下，从各仓库运走了14,900袋碎小麦。这批小麦是1941年12月8日之前由美国红十字会上海分会从美国接收的，系美国人民捐赠。

有关小麦的分发程序见附单。该清单由瑞士人 Ed. Egle 先生交给卑职，他是圆明园路97号西伯海格纳公司（Siber Hegner & Co.）经理，也是国际红十字会协会的委员。

此致
敬礼

（签名）Wan Bron Man
副督察长

EAGLE

SHANGHAI 30th May 1947.

Messrs. J. L. & Co. Ltd.,
Shanghai.

Attention: Mr. K. Shiroku.

Dear Sirs,

For your records I enclose statement, showing how
the distribution has been effected of 14,900 bags of tinned meat
which I had taken over from the American Red Cross.

I also attach a carbon copy of a letter, by which the
various parties were advised of their allotment. You will notice
that I made a charge of Jap¥ 3.-- per bag to cover storage and
transportation expenses, but no such charge was made of course on
the 1,500 bags reserved for the prisoners of war, also the charge
was not collected from the Guyao Famine Relief Committee on the
1,500 bags given to them, as they took delivery directly from the
central Hongkew wharf.

I have paid out to this date for storage and transportation
expenses on these goods Jap¥ 31,945.55, but there will be some
small expenses to be paid by the time all the stocks are cleared.
The charges which I shall recover on the basis of Jap¥ 3.-- per bag
will amount to Jap¥ 33,315.--. There will thus be a small surplus,
which I shall incorporate into the amount which was kindly paid to
me by H.M. Navy, and which will be used for some charitable purpose
to be decided upon later in consultation with yourselves.

I have the honour to remain, Dear Sirs,

Yours respectfully,

〔此处转录不清〕

EAGLE

上海 1947年5月30日。

致 J. L. & Co. Ltd.,
上海。

收件人：K. Shiroku 先生。

敬启者：

为供贵方存档，兹附上说明一份，列明我从美国红十字会接管的14,900袋罐头肉的分发情况。

我还附上一封信的副本，信中通知了各方其分配额度。请注意，我为支付仓储和运输费用，按每袋3日元收取费用，但当然未对预留给战俘的1,500袋收取此类费用；此外，给予高要赈灾委员会的1,500袋也未向其收费，因为他们是直接从虹口中心码头提货的。

截至目前，我已为这些货物的仓储和运输费用支付了31,945.55日元，但在所有库存清完之前，还将有一些小额费用需要支付。我将按每袋3日元的标准收回的费用总额将达33,315日元。因此将有一笔小额盈余，我将把它并入英国皇家海军 kindly 支付给我的款项中，该款项将用于慈善目的，具体用途日后将与贵方协商决定。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. _________
S.S., Special Branch. Station,
REPORT
Date Dec. 11, 1937.
Subject Reference attached letter from International Red Cross.

Made by: _________ and _________ Forwarded by D.S.I. LORAN.

Reference the attached letter received from MRS.
Arthur . Young, Chairman, Shanghai Committee, Shanghai
International Red Cross, 129 Nanking Road, with the instructions
of D. C. (Special Branch) thereon, examination by this Section
of the documents which accompanied the letter revealed them to be
incomplete. Consequently, Mrs. Young was communicated with on
9.12.37, with the result that a Chinese representative called
at Headquarters on 9.11.37, and was given a list of the items,
the dialogue of which was not supplied to the Police. This
person promised to supply the necessary dialogue on 10.12.37,
but failed to do so. On 14.11.37, D.S.I. Loran communicated
with Mrs. Young and was informed that the letter was winding up
the affairs of her Committee and that the work of the latter was
being handed over to Dr. J.L. Baker, Director of the International
Red Cross. Asked whether Dr. Baker would be proceeding with
the proposed broadcast, Mrs. Young stated that she did not know
and suggested that no reply to her letter be sent but that the
matter be left in abeyance.

Attached hereto is a list of the items submitted
for approval. The items which were accompanied by dialogue
have been marked "A". Examination of the dialogue in hand
failed to reveal anything objectionable.

〔此处有手写签名及 D. S. I. 字样〕

D. C. (Special Branch).

（左侧页边批注及印章）：
C.P.

事由 参考所附来自国际红十字会的信件。

制作人：_________ 和 _________ 由副督察长 LORAN 转发。

参考所附来自南京路129号上海国际红十字会上海委员会主席 Arthur . Young 夫人的信件，根据特科副主任的指示，本科对该信所附文件进行了审查，发现文件不全。因此，于1937年12月9日与 Young 夫人取得联系，结果是一名中方代表于1937年11月9日来到总部，获知了一份未向警方提供对白的节目清单。此人承诺于1937年12月10日提供必要的对白，但未履行。1937年11月14日，副督察长 Loran 与 Young 夫人联系，获悉该信旨在结束其委员会的事务，后者工作正移交给国际红十字会主任 J.L. Baker 博士。当问及 Baker 博士是否会继续进行拟议的广播时，Young 夫人表示她不知道，并建议不要回复她的信，此事暂搁置。

兹附上提交审批的节目清单。附有对白的节目已标记为“A”。对手头对白的审查未发现任何不当之处。

〔此处有手写签名及 D. S. I. 字样〕

Major F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police
Municipal Council
Shanghai

Sir,

The Shanghai International Red Cross is conducting a campaign to raise funds to carry on its work of giving relief to the hundreds of thousands of refugees now within the International Settlement, the French Concession and in the Nantao Safety Zone. The need is very urgent, and the Campaign Committee desires to conduct an appeal by radio.

I have the honour therefore to submit to you the accompanying documents containing the texts of the dialogue of the items to be broadcasted in connection with this campaign. I feel confident that as these items are being currently rendered commercially, you will find no objection to them for this charitable purpose. No material of a political nature, or any utterances that might disturb the peace of this community, will be used in this connection.

I feel that I need not emphasize to you the obvious benefit of such work to the community in providing relief and lessening the danger of outbreak of lawlessness and of epidemics among these unfortunates. It is

先生：

上海国际红十字会正在进行一项筹款活动，以维持其向目前位于公共租界、法租界及南市安全区内的数十万难民提供救济的工作。需求十分迫切，劝募委员会希望通过无线电广播进行劝募。

因此，我谨向您提交随附文件，其中包含拟在此次活动中广播的节目对话文本。我相信，鉴于这些节目目前正作为商业内容播出，您不会反对将其用于此慈善目的。在此活动中，不会使用任何具有政治性质的材料，或任何可能扰乱本社区安宁的言论。

我认为无需向您强调此类工作对社区的明显益处，即为这些不幸者提供救济，并降低他们中间爆发不法行为及疫病的风险。这是

hoped therefore that your approval of this radio appeal

expedite the matter, we shall be glad to make a repre-
sentative to see you personally and answer any questions
you might wish to ask.

Yours faithfully,

〔此处转录不清〕

INTREDCROSS

Major F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police
Municipal Council
Shanghai

Sir,

The Shanghai International Red Cross is conducting
a campaign to raise funds to carry on its work of giving
relief to the hundreds of thousands of refugees now
within the International Settlement, the French Conces-
sion and in the Nantao Safety Zone. The need is very
urgent, and the Campaign Committee desires to conduct
an appeal by radio.

I have the honour therefore to submit to you the
accompanying documents containing the texts of the
dialogue of the items to be broadcasted in connection
with this campaign. I feel confident that as these items
are being currently rendered commercially, you will find
no objection to them for this charitable purpose. No
material of a political nature, or any utterances that
might disturb the peace of this community, will be used
in this connection.

I feel that I need not emphasize to you the obvious
benefit of such work to the community in providing
relief and lessening the danger of outbreak of lawless-
ness and of epidemics among these unfortunates. It is

上海

先生：

上海国际红十字会正在进行
一项筹款活动，以维持其向目前
位于公共租界、法租界及南市安
全区内的数十万难民提供救济的
工作。需求十分迫切，劝募委员
会希望通过无线电广播进行劝募。

因此，我谨向您提交
随附文件，其中包含拟在
此次活动中广播的节目对
话文本。我相信，鉴于这
些节目目前正作为商业内
容播出，您不会反对将其
用于此慈善目的。在此活
动中，不会使用任何具有
政治性质的材料，或任何
可能扰乱本社区安宁的言
论。

我认为无需向您强调
此类工作对社区的明显益
处，即为这些不幸者提供
救济，并降低他们中间爆
发不法行为及疫病的风险。这是
